An '''Emergency button''' was a communication device used for quick communication to a nearby authority.<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which includes the use of an emergency button that occurs several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] arrived on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> a [[Colonist/Legends|colonist]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] named [[Handon Guld]], used an emergency button to quickly contact the nearby [[Jedi Enclave]], following his murder of [[Calder Nettic]] and subsequent injury at the hands of [[Rickard Lusoff]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
